details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: At any nonempty stage $\mathcal G$ of the recursive teaching process, choose one concept h with a minimum teaching set. As for ordinary teaching dimension, h has a teaching set of size at most $|\mathcal G|-1\leq|\mathcal H|-1$. Taking the maximum over stages proves the bound.
name: Size / Recursive Teaching Dimension
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
